newsitem.title: USA: Simione says probe won't hurt business.
newsitem.headline: Simione says probe won't hurt business.

text.p: Simione Central Holdings Inc said Monday it received an administrative subpoena from the Inspector General's office of the U.S. Department of Health and Human Resources for copies of documents relating to agency support services it provides to home health care agencies.

The company added that government officials said neither it nor any of its employees are the target of the investigation and it believes the inquiry will have no material affect on its overall business.
